body.statement: For every triangular array \((B^{(n)},w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\) and every fixed \(0<\alpha\le1/4\), \[\mathcal R_\alpha(w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\to0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\omega_\alpha(w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\to0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\rho_0(w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\to0.\] In particular, \(S^{(n)}\to0\) is sufficient but not necessary.
body.justification: The computable equivalence \(\omega_\alpha\to0\Longleftrightarrow\rho_0\to0\) and the sufficient implication to vanishing risk are proved.
body.gap: The reverse implication from vanishing minimax risk to vanishing modulus remains exactly the unresolved unrestricted erasure lower bound.
body.consumer: Once the lower bound closes, designers obtain the full intrinsic consistency boundary; before then, the proved trimming criterion is a sufficient design certificate.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove that vanishing minimax expected length forces the capped modulus to vanish.
obligation.obstruction: That reverse implication is a direct consequence of the still-open global water-filling lower bound and cannot be obtained from the proved upper intervals.
obligation.attempted: The equivalence of the two computable moduli, the sufficient risk implication, and a valid clique-array witness showing that \(S\to0\) is not necessary were proved.
obligation.partial_result:
For fixed \(\alpha\), write \(x=\log(1/\alpha)>1\), and let \(\omega_z\) denote the capped program with budget \(z\).  Monotonicity and rescaling of feasible vectors give
\[
 \omega_1\le\omega_x\le\sqrt{x}\,\omega_1.
\]
Indeed, an optimizer at budget \(x\), divided by \(\sqrt x\), remains in \([0,1]^L\) and is feasible at budget one.  The proved trimming duality gives
\[
 \omega_1\le\rho_0\le3\omega_1,
\]
so \(\omega_\alpha\to0\) if and only if \(\rho_0\to0\).  The trimmed upper bound and confidence-level duality also give
\(\mathcal R_\alpha\le8\omega_\alpha\), proving
\(\omega_\alpha\to0\Longrightarrow\mathcal R_\alpha\to0\).
Conversely, \(\mathcal R_\alpha\to0\Longrightarrow\omega_\alpha\to0\)
is exactly the unresolved all-procedure erasure lower bound.

The last sentence about \(S\) is already certified independently of
that converse.  Cauchy--Schwarz gives
\(\omega_\alpha\le\sqrt{xS}\), so \(S\to0\) is sufficient.  It is not
necessary: for \(k\ge1\), take one block of size \(2k\), let
\(n_k=2k\,2^k\), and partition all remaining units into singletons.
The large block has \(w=2^{-k}\), \(q=2^{-2k}\), and contribution one
to \(S\); the singleton contribution is
\(2(n_k-2k)/n_k^2\to0\).  Hence \(S\to1\), while trimming the large
block gives \(\rho_\alpha\to0\) and therefore
\(\mathcal R_\alpha\to0\).
